content_of_post_to_answer: Does checking the morning news usually ruin your mood for the rest of the day?
answer: Morning news can ruin your mood because it gives you problems to worry about before you’ve even begun your own day. The subtle distinction is between being informed and feeling responsible for everything you learn. I’ve explored this pattern further in my other writing on my Quora profile. Staying informed matters, but so does recognizing that awareness doesn't require carrying every headline with you.
